samples.label: clear
samples.description: No obstacles in view, open path ahead
samples.notes: CONFIRMED CLEAR - 7ft 4in ahead, 2ft 6in on each side. Couch detection is false positive or distant object.

samples.label: blocked_center
samples.description: Obstacle directly ahead (6in foam pad at 1ft distance)
samples.notes: 6in diameter foam pad placed 1ft directly ahead. CENTER zone jumped from 14% to 42%. Header CENTER jumped from 2% to 66%.

samples.label: blocked_right
samples.description: Obstacle on right side (6in foam pad at 1ft ahead, 1ft to right)
samples.notes: 6in foam pad at ~45deg angle (1ft ahead, 1ft right). RIGHT zone jumped from 25% to 46%. LEFT and CENTER unchanged.

samples.label: blocked_left
samples.description: Obstacle on left side (6in foam pad at 1ft ahead, 1ft to left)
samples.notes: 6in foam pad at ~45deg angle (1ft ahead, 1ft left). LEFT zone jumped from 24% to 41% (+17%). CENTER unchanged at ~13-14%.

samples.label: blocked_close
samples.description: Very close obstacle (6in foam pad within 6 inches directly ahead)
samples.notes: 6in foam pad placed <6in directly ahead. CENTER zone jumped to 70% (header 82%). Much higher than blocked_center (42%) confirming proximity correlation.

samples.label: blocked_far
samples.description: Distant obstacle (6in foam pad approximately 3ft directly ahead)
samples.notes: 6in foam pad at ~3ft ahead. CENTER zone only 18% (header 10%), barely above baseline 14%. At this distance, small obstacles are NOT reliably detected by depth alone.

samples.label: passage_narrow
samples.description: Narrow passage with obstacles on both sides (box left, foam pad right, ~1ft from robot each)
samples.notes: Box on left, foam pad on right, each ~1ft away. LEFT jumped to 41% (+17%), RIGHT to 44% (+19%), CENTER stays at 16% (clear). Signature pattern for hallway/corridor.

samples.label: wall
samples.description: Large flat surface (white wall) approximately 1ft directly ahead, perpendicular
samples.notes: Pure white wall at 1ft, perpendicular. All zones uniformly elevated (~44-46%), signature pattern for wall/large flat surface. Depth estimation works reliably on textureless surfaces.
